import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.prompt import Confirm

def test_confirm_markup_error() -> None:
    console = Console(markup=False)
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        Confirm.ask("Continue", console=console)
    # The error message should not contain markup, but currently it does
    # because markup is not explicitly enabled in on_validate_error
    assert console.get_error_stream().getvalue() == "[prompt.invalid]Please enter Y or N\n"
